description: Search the free CC0 library of 3D models, PBR textures, HDRIs, character animations, sound effects and music by meaning and filters. Every model is a GLB measured in metres, +Y up, origin at the base. Every animation (type animation) is a humanoid clip in place, with its length, whether it loops, and animate_id: pass that id in animate_model's animations to put it on any rigged humanoid, free. Every sound (type audio) has its length, loudness in LUFS and whether it loops, measured from the file, and audio_url, an MP3 any browser plays; loop_url is an AAC M4A of a loop, for Safari; the MP3 decodes to its exact length in Chrome and Firefox. Check size_m before placing an asset; use min_size_m >= 2 for floors and walls. previews (max 6) attaches thumbnails, which is cheaper than downloading the wrong asset. Each result has match (strong, good or weak); when none is better than weak the answer says so, and generate_model (generate_sound_effect or generate_music for sounds) is the way to get it. Read-only, free with a free account.

category.description: A category slug; see the categories in the results. Sounds: sfx, ui, ambience, voice, music. Animations: move, idle, fight, ranged, work.

format.description: A file format we serve it in.

loop.description: Sounds: true for one that loops without a click (music beds, ambience), false for one-shots. Animations: true for a cycle (walk, idle), false for one that plays once (jump, sword combo).

maps.description: Must have all of these maps.

max_seconds.description: Sounds and animations: at most this long.

max_size_m.description: The largest side at most this many metres.

min_seconds.description: Sounds and animations: at least this long.

min_size_m.description: The largest side at least this many metres. Use 2 or more for floors and walls.

pack.description: A pack id from a result ("kn:mini-skate"): only assets from that kit, to keep a game in one style.

previews.description: Attach this many thumbnails as images, so you can look before downloading.

q.description: What you need, in words: "wooden barrel", "mossy rock", "sci-fi crate", "footsteps on gravel", "calm forest music".

similar_to.description: An asset id: the nearest to it by meaning.

name: search_assets
title: Search free CC0 3D assets, animations and sounds
